text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the February Stakes. Many 
spectators jeer, calling it a match 
between the "Biting Umamusume" and the 
"Little Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Shinko Windy was entirely 
serious. She declared that she would run 
faster than anyone and overturn everyone's 
opinion of her today.
